---
title: "First week of MDS"
date: 2026-09-10
---

Exciting, challenging, and overwhelming - sometimes all three before lunch.

Figuring out course logistics, labs, exploring the campus and meeting batchmates has been both fun and daunting.
There's a particular kind of low-grade anxiety that comes from
suspecting you've missed an announcement somewhere.

Campus is still a puzzle. I've walked past the same building twice looking for
it more than once.

The batchmates have been the best surprise. Everyone arrived from somewhere
different - different degrees, different countries, different reasons for being
here - and there's a nice levelling effect in all of us being equally lost in
the first week.

Daunting and fun are apparently not opposites. On to week two.
